album.ipa: hˈɪɹ ɑːɹ jʊɹ stˈɪkɚz ænd kɹˈaʊnz!
album.text: Here are your stickers and crowns!

check.ipa: həlˈoʊ! ɪf juː kæn hˈɪɹ mˌiː, ðə sˈaʊnd ɪz wˈɜːkɪŋ.
check.text: Hello! If you can hear me, the sound is working.

crown.ipa: juː ˈɜːnd ɐ kɹˈaʊn! ɡɹˈeɪt plˈeɪɪŋ tədˈeɪ!
crown.text: You earned a crown! Great playing today!

intro_letters.ipa: lˈɛts fˈaɪnd lˈɛɾɚz! lˈɪsən, ðˈɛn tˈæp ðə lˈɛɾɚɹ aɪ sˈeɪ.
intro_letters.text: Let's find letters! Listen, then tap the letter I say.

intro_numbers.ipa: lˈɛts plˈeɪ wɪð nˈʌmbɚz! lˈɪsən, ðˈɛn tˈæp ðə ɹˈaɪt wˌʌn.
intro_numbers.text: Let's play with numbers! Listen, then tap the right one.

intro_sounds.ipa: lˈɛts plˈeɪ wɪð lˈɛɾɚ sˈaʊndz! lˈɪsən tə ðə sˈaʊnd, ðˈɛn tˈæp ðə lˈɛɾɚ ðæt mˈeɪks ɪt.
intro_sounds.text: Let's play with letter sounds! Listen to the sound, then tap the letter that makes it.

intro_words.ipa: lˈɛts ɹˈiːd wˈɜːdz! lˈɪsən, ðˈɛn tˈæp ðə wˈɜːd aɪ sˈeɪ.
intro_words.text: Let's read words! Listen, then tap the word I say.

match_prompt.ipa: fˈaɪnd ðə lˈoʊɚkˌeɪs lˈɛɾɚ ðæt ɡoʊz wɪð ðɪs kˈæpɪɾəl lˈɛɾɚ.
match_prompt.text: Find the lowercase letter that goes with this capital letter.

startq_x.text: #say:Which letter makes the sound at the end of|*box|*Box.

w2n_prompt.ipa: wˌɪtʃ nˈʌmbɚ dˈʌz ðɪs wˈɜːd sˈeɪ?
w2n_prompt.text: Which number does this word say?
